name: Grade 8 IT Practice: May Week 13 - Archive and Reflection
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: To store files neatly for later.
words.example: The student can archive the final website files in one folder.

words.definition: A saved document, image, or project on a computer.
words.example: The HTML file was saved with a clear project name.

words.definition: Work that is turned in to the teacher.
words.example: The submission included the link, screenshots, and reflection.

words.definition: A change that fixes a mistake.
words.example: The correction fixed a missing image credit.

words.definition: A final note about the strongest portfolio evidence and remaining improvements.
words.example: The reflection described the strongest part of the project.

words.definition: A place used to organize files.
words.example: The folder kept images, code, and notes together.
